args.checkContents:
#!/bin/bash
# Check that getIconBySlug uses a Map lookup instead of Array.prototype.find

SOURCE_FILE="src/lib/icons.ts"

# Check 1: Verify iconsBySlug Map is defined at module level
if ! grep -q "const iconsBySlug = new Map" "$SOURCE_FILE"; then
  echo "FAIL: iconsBySlug Map not found in source"
  exit 1
fi

# Check 2: Verify getIconBySlug uses iconsBySlug.get() instead of icons.find()
# Extract the getIconBySlug function body and check it
FUNC_BODY=$(sed -n '/export function getIconBySlug/,/^}/p' "$SOURCE_FILE")

if ! echo "$FUNC_BODY" | grep -q "iconsBySlug.get"; then
  echo "FAIL: getIconBySlug does not use iconsBySlug.get()"
  exit 1
fi

if echo "$FUNC_BODY" | grep -q "\.find("; then
  echo "FAIL: getIconBySlug still uses Array.prototype.find()"
  exit 1
fi

# Check 3: Verify the function signature is correct
if ! echo "$FUNC_BODY" | grep -q "getIconBySlug(slug: string)"; then
  echo "FAIL: getIconBySlug signature changed unexpectedly"
  exit 1
fi

echo "PASS: getIconBySlug correctly uses O(1) Map lookup"
exit 0
